# Roy Lichtenstein — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Roy Lichtenstein known for?", "Whaam!"),
    ("What field did Roy Lichtenstein work in?", "Pop Art"),
    ("What is lived?", "1923-1997"),
    ("What is field?", "Pop Art"),
    ("What is known for?", "Whaam!"),
    ("What is note?", "Comics blown up to high art"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
